issues.title: D0 runtime source is not obligatorily sealed/pinned
issues.impact: A sealed admission may omit d0_service.py from controller_source_pins. gpu_window verifies only keys supplied by the admission, then dynamically imports d0_service.py. d0_service itself starts a GPU service without comparing its own bytes to an admission hash. The new D0 operation therefore lacks the source-freeze contract applied to the master, hybrid service, measurement runner, and eta script.
issues.root_cause: The controller has extensible pin iteration rather than an exact required pin set, and the newly added d0_service has no self-pin gate.
issues.fix: Require the exact source-pin set to include resolved gpu_window.py, hybrid_service.py, window_measure.py, and d0_service.py; in d0_service.execute compare sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()) against its admission pin before output mkdir/Popen. Add CPU tests showing missing or wrong d0 pin rejects before Popen.
